sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Shoreline is a location in Escape from Tarkov. It is the fourth map that was added to the game.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: The Shoreline area makes up a large part of the outskirts of Tarkov and is located next to the Port. The area houses a partially abandoned village, modern private housing, agricultural fields, long stretches of beach, a boating facility, gas station, weather station, and a cellular tower as well as other commercial facilities. Shoreline's main point of interest is the Azure Coast health resort which consists of several blocks, exclusively powered by a nearby hydroelectric power plant. The resort had previously been used as temporary accommodation for members of TerraGroup and the corporation's associated divisions in preparation for the evacuation of the Tarkov Port.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: Shoreline is initially only accessible by transiting. Direct access from the location selection screen is unlocked upon progressing through the story chapter Tour.

sections.heading: Features
sections.text:
- Stationary weapons in the form of AGS-30 30x29mm automatic grenade launchers and NSV Utyos 12.7x108 heavy machine guns.
- Be aware of Border Snipers and Minefields!

sections.heading: Port Terminal
sections.text: The Terminal is guarded by RUAF soldiers and machine gunners. They are neutral towards the player but will open fire when they get shot, and if a player gets too close to the Terminal without presenting an access item at the port garrison intercom. Check our maps to keep a safe distance.

Trivia
sections.text:
- The location was first expanded with patch 0.5.0.811 on December 26, 2017.
- The location was completely reworked and expanded with patch 0.14.0.0.28333 on December 27, 2023.
- The health resort in-universe is called the "Azure Coast" resort, or alternatively the "Côte d’Azur" resort.
- This location is based on the abandoned sanatorium "Strelna" which is located near St. Petersburg.
